title: Reduced characteristic number criteria for $T^k$- and $(\mathbb Z_2)^k$-equivariant bordisms
summary: Classical equivariant bordism theories require computing the full collection of equivariant characteristic numbers to detect whether an equivariant manifold bounds equivariantly or not. This paper establishes simplified equivariant bordism characterizations for two families of equivariant manifolds with isolated fixed points: unitary $T^k$-manifolds and closed smooth $(\mathbb{Z}_2)^k$-manifolds.
